rows.label: Core: at least two courses from the core list
rows.note: Every course on the core list is 3 credits, so two courses is 6 credits. Extra core courses are not counted toward the focus-area courses here (the stricter reading).

rows.label: Four more courses from the three focus areas (transportation and energy, climate-energy-water, finance and policy)
rows.note: Six courses in all, two from the core list, so four remain. The remaining credits are read as 12 (18 minus the 6 core credits); a 1.5-credit course therefore needs another course alongside it. A course appearing in two areas counts once. Courses outside the printed lists need a petition (see the petition confirm item).

rows.label: Check the six courses add up to at least 18 credits
At least 9 of the minor's credits must be separate from the required courses your major uses
rows.note: The board holds the minor to at most 9 credits shared with your major (any major row, stricter than Cornell, which only counts required major courses). Confirm the real count with your advisor.

rows.label: Open to Engineering students in any major except Civil Engineering
rows.note: Civil Engineering students follow the Smart Cities concentration of their own major instead.

rows.label: Your major must approve taking this minor
Finish all requirements for your undergraduate degree, completing the minor during your continuous undergraduate enrollment
A course or focus area outside the printed lists counts only if you petitioned and it was approved
Apply for certification of the minor once the coursework is finished
